import ctypes
import os
import math

# Load the dynamic libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_cdf_exponential_Pinv(const double P, const double mu);
gsl.gsl_cdf_exponential_Pinv.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_exponential_Pinv.restype = ctypes.c_double

def compute_exponential_quantile(P, mu):
    """Compute the inverse cumulative distribution function for an exponential distribution."""
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_exponential_Pinv(P, mu)

def assert_test():
    """Test cases for compute_exponential_quantile function."""
    # Test case 1: P = 0.5, mu = 1.0
    result = compute_exponential_quantile(0.5, 1.0)
    expected = -1.0 * math.log1p(-0.5)
    assert abs(result - expected) < 1e-9, f"Test case 1 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 2: P = 0.1, mu = 2.0
    result = compute_exponential_quantile(0.1, 2.0)
    expected = -2.0 * math.log1p(-0.1)
    assert abs(result - expected) < 1e-9, f"Test case 2 failed: {result} != {expected}"

    # Test case 3: P = 0.9, mu = 0.5
    result = compute_exponential_quantile(0.9, 0.5)
    expected = -0.5 * math.log1p(-0.9)
    assert abs(result - expected) < 1e-9, f"Test case 3 failed: {result} != {expected}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
